Chapter 1187 - 9 Preaching (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 1187: Chapter 9 Preaching (Seeking Subscriptions)

Inside the grand hall.

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan in astonishment.

What did he just hear?

The Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage, these two ancient Heavenly Venerates, were completely left in the Hei Yu Nest by Lin Yuan?

And Lin Yuan was still asking whether leaving behind the Heavenly Venerable primary battle bodies was worth a million merits?

"I was fortunate, the Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage did not know my strength, so they dared to delve deep."

Lin Yuan said.

This was indeed the truth.

If the Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate were still stationed at the Hei Yu Nest, the Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerable Sage, even if they had intentions towards the Hei Yu Nest, could not have infiltrated so easily, let alone delve deeply into the Hei Yu Nest.

The reason Lin Yuan was able to keep the two Heavenly Venerates was due to his own strength restraint.

Secondly, it was because the opponents were careless.

Additionally, the two Heavenly Venerates were also hesitant to delay any further.

Fearing supporting forces would arrive, they decisively obliterated their physical bodies and souls.

"That’s not what I’m asking."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country stared at Lin Yuan with a surprised gaze: "You were able to restrain Jihan and Xuanyin by relying on yourself?"

After speaking, the emperor tentatively asked: "Have you stepped into the Heavenly Venerable Realm?"

He understood that the defense formation of the Hei Yu Nest hardly allowed the retention of a Heavenly Venerate-level powerhouse, let alone two Heavenly Venerates infiltrating together?

"Pretty much."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Since he came to talk about this matter, he was definitely prepared to reveal some of his strength.

The Heavenly Venerable Realm of the imperial clan is different from a normal Heavenly Venerate.

Because the path taken by the imperial clan essentially differs from that of normal cultivators.

The imperial clan is primarily focused on excavating their ancestor bloodline, whereas cultivators perceive the rules of the heavens and earth.

What is referred to as the imperial clan’s Heavenly Venerate shackle is that the upper limit of the ancestor bloodlines of the six ancient countries is all locked at the peak of the Great Lord, making it impossible to ascend to the Heavenly Venerate by continuing to excavate the bloodline power.

Although the imperial clan’s Great Lords can step into the Heavenly Venerable Realm by comprehending the rules of the heavens and earth, such Heavenly Venerates are no different from other Heavenly Venerates and are not unique to the imperial clan.

In simple terms, the core imperial clans of the six ancient countries all yearn to excavate their ancestor bloodlines to the Heavenly Venerate level.

"Pretty much?"

An immense wave surged in the heart of the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

What Lin Yuan referred to as pretty much was the lifelong goal pursued by many core members of the imperial clan of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Many core members of the imperial clan have paid an unknown price to break the bloodline shackle.

"I had some gains not long ago." Lin Yuan raised his right hand and slightly activated the Divine Skill ’Lieyang Kaitian.’

This Divine Skill stemmed from deep within the bloodline, refined through the Martial Arts Evolution Road, likely originating from a certain talent of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

With this Divine Skill, Lin Yuan could fully explain his exploitation of the bloodline.

In fact, this was indeed the case, leveraging the advantages of the Martial Arts Evolution Road, Lin Yuan’s development of the Fierce Sun ancestor’s bloodline is far ahead of the Fierce Sun imperial clansmen.

"Indeed, the aura of the ancestor..."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at the source of Fierce Sun condensed by Lin Yuan, with a complex expression.

He could clearly sense the source of Fierce Sun brimming with a rich aura of the ancestor.

"Galaxy... thank you."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan and said earnestly: "You have given us a glimpse of hope for an alternate path."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country saw from Lin Yuan the potential to break the bloodline shackle of the imperial clan, at least not a desperate situation.

"Actually, I can announce my method of excavating the ancestor bloodline to the public..." Lin Yuan pondered and voiced his ultimate purpose.

He had awakened the Divine Skill ’Lieyang Kaitian’ through the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

Therefore, the method of excavating the ancestor bloodline is naturally the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

In the Chaos Void, spreading one’s evolutionary path helps form a stable ’anchor point’ and ’path marker,’ beneficial for breaking through time loops.

Hence, whenever Lin Yuan descended into a traversed world in the past, he would disseminate his evolutionary path in the latter stages.

In this origin world, Lin Yuan also plans to attempt the dissemination of his evolutionary path, with the focal point being the excavation of his ancestor bloodline.

The Martial Arts Evolution Road indeed possesses such a capability.

...

In the Chaos Void, the dissemination of various branches of the Martial Arts Evolution is entrusted to the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

As for this Fang Yuan World... Lin Yuan does not intend to give up either.

The level of the origin world is not at all weaker than the Chaos Void.

A domain of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country may not match the size of the Void Domain in the Chaos Void.

But the number of living beings contained within is not inferior to the latter.

In such a life-rich world, once the branches of the Martial Arts Evolution Road are disseminated, it would aid Lin Yuan no less than spreading in the Chaos Void.

...

"Method of excavating the bloodline?"

The pupils of the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country slightly contracted.

Normal cultivators perceiving the rules of the heavens and earth have traces to follow and laws to rely on, but excavating one’s ancestor bloodline? It emphasizes more on innate talent.

"Is there really a method to excavate the bloodline on a deep level?"

The tone of the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was rather urgent.

If Lin Yuan breaking the Heavenly Venerate shackle only showed these imperial clans that excavating the bloodline is not a desperate path, still holding potential to reach the Heavenly Venerate level.

Now, if what Lin Yuan said is true, it would have an unprecedented impact on the entire imperial clan of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

"I can try to summarize it."

Lin Yuan looked at the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and suddenly said: "But I have a request."

"What is the request?"

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country immediately said: "As long as it doesn’t contradict the ancestor’s will, I can agree."

"I hope that the method I finally summarize to excavate the ancestor bloodline can be disseminated throughout the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, and not confined solely to the imperial clan."
